intel.title: The pilgrimage begins
intel.summary: You have set out to learn the Anchor Town's virtue.
intel.subject: world

intel.title: The Mantra of Integrity
intel.summary: Speak it only at its own shrine; elsewhere it opens nothing.
intel.subject: shrine_compassion

intel.title: Whereabouts of the Shrine
intel.summary: Half a day along the shore. Look for the standing stones.
intel.subject: compassion_shrine_interior

intel.title: Whereabouts of the Shrine (from the beggar)
intel.summary: The stones by the sea, where they go to be quiet.
intel.subject: compassion_shrine_interior

intel.title: Whereabouts of the Shrine (dubious)
intel.summary: Up the hill, past the mill. Everyone knows.
intel.subject: compassion_shrine_interior

intel.title: The Rule of the Shrine
intel.summary: The word opens nothing but at its own stones. Speak it there, and it is done. (Refutes the drunk's hill.)
intel.subject: compassion_shrine_interior

intel.title: Whereabouts of the Sigil-Stone
intel.summary: Hidden where the cat sleeps — the bakery oven-ledge.
intel.subject: sigil_stone_slot1

intel.title: A Dream of the Sigil-Stone
intel.summary: A cat asleep on warm brick. Under it, a mark.
intel.subject: sigil_stone_slot1

intel.title: The Mantra-Keeper
intel.summary: Holds the mantra behind an honesty test.
intel.subject: mantra_keeper
